name: Outrigger Waikiki Beach Resort
positioning: Beachfront resort set directly on Waikiki Beach, with a surf school in front of the hotel, a club lounge above the sand and Hawaiian cultural activities
best_for: Travelers who want to learn to surf or paddle right off the beach
Guests who want ocean-view balconies and club lounge access on Waikiki Beach
Couples planning a Hawaiian vow renewal

facts.text: The resort is set directly on Waikiki Beach, at 2335 Kalakaua Avenue in Honolulu.
Guests can surf where Duke Kahanamoku shared his love of the ocean with the world.
Rooms have private balconies that connect guests to the ocean, skyline and energy of Waikiki.
Club Room and Suite guests get all-day access to the Voyager 47 Club Lounge, which overlooks Waikiki Beach.
The Voyager 47 Club Lounge is perched directly above the sand.
The beach can be seen from the pool area.
The Aqualani Beach and Ocean Recreation desk on the beachfront books surfing, paddle boarding and more.
Cultural activities at the resort range from hula lessons to lei making, and ukulele lessons are offered too.
Duke's Waikiki is a beachfront restaurant on the sands of Waikiki Beach, with island cuisine, cocktails and live music.
Blue Note Hawaii is a jazz and dinner club with two performances nightly.
The resort offers a Hawaiian vow renewal ceremony.
The resort is pet-friendly, for a fee.

highlights.text: Faith Surf School is directly in front of the hotel on Waikiki Beach, teaching surfing, stand-up paddleboarding and riding a wave in an outrigger canoe.
Through the Surfers in Residence program, surfers stay at the resort and share their stories and craft with guests.
Oceanfront rooms have an unobstructed ocean view, with Waikiki Beach right below the private balcony.
On Sundays, local music legend Henry Kapono plays from 4 to 6 pm on the beachfront at the Barefoot Bar.

considerations.text: The drive to the airport can take from 30 minutes to an hour, depending on the time of day.
WhataHotel notes it is a busy tourist area with high foot traffic.
